# pip-audit -- Reference
<!-- Generated By: Claude Code (Claude Opus 4.6) -->

## Overview

Python dependency security scanner developed by Trail of Bits with Google
funding [33]. Licensed Apache 2.0 [32]. Stands as the Python Packaging
Authority's (PyPA) official tool for dependency security checking [34].

## Developers

- William Woodruff and Alex Cameron of Trail of Bits [33]
- Funded by Google [33]
- Supported by Dustin Ingram (Google senior developer advocate) [33]

## How It Works

- Resolves dependencies by installing them in a dedicated environment [32]
- Cross-references installed packages against vulnerability databases [31]
- Supports multiple output formats: JSON, CycloneDX JSON/XML [32]

## Vulnerability Services

| Service | Flag | Source |
|---------|------|--------|
| PyPI (default) | `--vulnerability-service pypi` | PyPA Advisory Database via PyPI JSON API [31] |
| OSV | `--vulnerability-service osv` | Google OSV database [31] |
| Ecosyste.ms | `--vulnerability-service esms` | Ecosyste.ms API [31] |
| Custom OSV | `--osv-url URL` | User-specified OSV endpoint [31] |

## Key Features

- `--fix` flag for automated remediation (free) [32][34]
- CycloneDX JSON/XML SBOM output [32]
- PEP 751 lockfile support [31]
- GitHub Action available (gh-action-pip-audit) [32]
- Custom OSV endpoint support [31]

## Limitations

- Does not include vulnerability severity ratings (no CVSS) [34][36]
- Can only scan at build time, not monitor running applications [36]
- Only catches known vulnerabilities [36]
- No malware or behavioral analysis
- No provenance verification

## pip-audit vs Safety

| Feature | pip-audit | Safety |
|---------|-----------|--------|
| Cost | Free (Apache 2.0) [32] | Non-commercial free / paid for commercial [57] |
| Database | PyPA Advisory DB / OSV [31] | Safety DB (monthly updates free) [57] |
| Fix suggestions | Free (--fix) [32][34] | Paid only [34] |
| CVSS scores | No [34][36] | Paid only [34] |
| DB update frequency | Continuous (via PyPI) [31] | Monthly (free) [57] |
| Commercial use | Yes [32] | Requires paid license [57] |
| Official PyPA tool | Yes [34] | No |
| Telemetry | None | Mandatory (disable with flag) [56] |

pip-audit project lead: "We wanted to build a tool that didn't have any
